_about: AUTHORED by the game team. Base maps for the game board. None needs an API key. Layers are raster tiles unless type is vector (drawn from content/backdrops). Licences need review before a public launch. Sensor positions on the map come from ARGUS (installed-devices coordinates); nothing here changes them.

layers.attribution: Imagery © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
layers.review_note: Esri World Imagery: confirm that a free, public educational game may use these tiles without an ArcGIS key, or get a free ArcGIS Location Platform key. Alternatives with open licences: swisstopo SWISSIMAGE (CH), PNOA (ES), regional orthophotos (IT, GR).
OpenStreetMap tile usage policy allows light use with attribution and no offline caching. For a large public launch, switch to a tile provider.
Drawn from content/backdrops (tools/fetch_backdrops.py). Works offline and wherever outside images are blocked; the game switches to it by itself when map pictures fail.
